answer: Mirrored interaction ledger: every identity must seed a distinct meadow of prior counterparties whose signed records predate it. A new identity inherits the full graph distance to the meadow, and duplicate clusters collapse because their neighbors overlap beyond a fixed Jaccard threshold, revealing shared history. Each agent also logs a rotating zenith of recent exchanges; identical zenith sequences expose copies. An attacker pays one organic grove of independently attested, timestamped relationships per puppet, plus the ongoing work of keeping disjoint histories from ever merging.
